acceptanceCriteria: TestWorkspaceBranchRootAndHealthy passes 20 consecutive runs under the same contention.
The cause of the load-dependent failures is identified from a reproduction under CPU contention, or the suspicion is closed with evidence.
body: Suspected defect, not confirmed. Observed 2026-10-04 on macOS (Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1, Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163) while running affected packages for V1-0714 and V1-0716 with host load averages between 45 and 130. Run 1 (V1-0714 worktree): internal/lspstdio hit the 30m package timeout. Run 2 (V1-0716 worktree at 99e13a88, 43 packages in one go test invocation): TestWorkspaceBranchRootAndHealthy subtests root, healthy and save failed at workspace_guard_unix_test.go:93 with `healthy initial: map[error:{"code":-32801,"message":"Overlay definition unavailable"} id:2 jsonrpc:"2.0"]`. Both times `go test -count=1 ./internal/lspstdio` alone passed immediately afterwards (14.7 s and 9.5 s). Neither change touched the package. Expected: the test passes or reports a deadline; actual: an overlay definition request is answered as unavailable under contention, which suggests a fixed wait or a readiness race in the test or the stdio server. Hosted CI occurrence: NOT_OBSERVED.
title: tests: internal/lspstdio TestWorkspaceBranchRootAndHealthy fails under host load (suspected readiness race)
